scope: Pinned SDK operation surface review and required proof-feed controls; proposed design, no implementation or execution claim
observed_surface: Top-level and child storage-root computation over deltas
required_controls: Missing point-read node is fetched at the certified parent and verified by owned SDK/runtime before use.
Wrong parent hash, proof root or node content refuses without enrolling an accounting cursor.
Iterator pagination and end-of-range must be authenticated; discovery RPC keys alone do not establish absence or completeness.
Child trie proof must bind its child identifier and parent child-root proof.
Root-write operations must have the required sibling/path nodes; unavailable proof preserves unknown output rather than inventing a state root.
Timeout, interrupted feed, lost acknowledgement and restart preserve exact request/debit identity and prior completed cursor.
Cumulative proof nodes/bytes and retries retain an end-to-end bounded native profile; receipt bounds remain separate.

Latch proof-feed and storage errors outside the SDK root tuple/hash lookup API; refuse enrollment even when SDK returns a plausible unchanged/default root. Preserve transient cause and retry eligibility.
implementation_owner: Astra max native producer lane; independent SDK design review underway
qualification: Sol medium actual original-runtime producer-to-Rust-to-Go test, not just mocked proof values or manually supplied complete directory
observed_error_fallbacks: storage_root returns the original root after logging a delta-trie calculation error.
child_storage_root substitutes a default root on child-root read error and retains the prior child root on delta-write error.
Ephemeral hash lookup converts underlying storage error into None after logging.
